title: fix(cloud-connection): install-local names the installed copy when the resolver refuses it on a re-install
body:
Fixes #34583

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：本地重装一个包时，如果被今天的校验拒收的是「已经装着的那份」(上次安装存下的副本),报错现在明确说是已装副本被拒、新包没有被判定，并给出出路：先卸载该包移除存下的副本，再安装这一版。状态码和错误码不变(仍是解析器自己的 422 与错误码)。
- 为什么改：以前同一种情况回「Package 'X' cannot be installed」,读起来像新包有问题，作者会去改一个根本没问题的新包。
- 风险与回滚：只改报错文字和两段 try 的拆分，状态码、错误码、details、"什么都没写入"的行为都不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` 的 `evaluateDeclaredRenames`(两侧各自一个 try)与 `declaredRefusalAnswer`(新的 `side` 参数与已装副本的句子);然后是测试文件末尾的 `#34583` describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/marketplace-install-local-resolver-refusal-34432.test.ts`,预期 10 个测试全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

On an install-local re-install, step 2c″ folds both the incoming body and the installed copy (the body the last install stored in the ledger) through the artifact resolver before it plans declared renames. Both folds sat in one `try`, and the catch answered either side's refusal as `Package 'X' cannot be installed: …`, which reads as a fault in the incoming package.

- `evaluateDeclaredRenames` now folds each side in its own `try`, the incoming body first. A refusal of the installed copy is answered by `declaredRefusalAnswer(manifestId, err, 'installed')`.
- `declaredRefusalAnswer` takes a `side` (default `'incoming'`, so every other step is unchanged). For `'installed'` the status, code and `details` stay the resolver's. The sentence becomes: "The installed copy of package 'X', stored here by its last install, is refused by this runtime: REASON A re-install compares the incoming version with that stored copy, so it cannot go ahead; the incoming version was not judged. Remove the stored copy first (uninstall 'X'), then install this version. Nothing was installed or written."
- No new error code and no wire-shape change.
- Step 2c′ (the schema upgrade gate) folds the same installed copy again. That fold can never meet this refusal, because 2c″ runs first over the same two bodies (both run only when `conflict === 'marketplace'`, both read `installedPackageSide(ctx, manifestId, previousLookup)`) and returns. A one-line comment there now says so. There is no second defect on that step.

## Tests

All pins go into the existing harness `marketplace-install-local-resolver-refusal-34432.test.ts` as a new top-level `describe`, following ruling record 6583487846. The dispatch suggested a new file; this file already holds the harness for this exact step.

- The installed copy is refused (a package entry still carrying the retired bare `indexes[].unique: true`) and the incoming version is well-formed: `422 INVALID_ARTIFACT_PACKAGE_ENTRY`. The message starts with the installed-copy sentence, names the remedy, and does not contain `Package 'X' cannot be installed:`. Nothing is registered, the stored copy is unchanged and no table is read.
- The remedy works: uninstalling (`DELETE …/:manifestId`, 200) and then installing the same version answers 200.
- The incoming version is refused over a well-formed installed copy: the message starts with `Package 'X' cannot be installed:` and does not mention the installed copy.
- Both copies are refused: the incoming package's refusal is the answer.
- CONTROL: a well-formed re-install answers 200, and the rename plan reads the stored copy.

**Fixture fix in the same file.** `composed()` now carries an empty top-level `datasources` map. Without it, step 2a (the datasource holder, `declaredDatasources` → `resolveStackCollection(…, 'datasources')`) meets the resolver's refusal first. Ablation D below shows that the existing #34432 incoming-side pins never reached 2c″ before this change: they stayed 10/10 green with 2c″'s incoming fold removed. With the map they go red. This is the same file and the same gate family, and the change is mechanical.

Measured at `32bda83ef0`:

<details><summary>Suite and package runs</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/marketplace-install-local-resolver-refusal-34432.test.ts` → `Tests  10 passed (10)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection typecheck && … build && … exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` → `Test Files  90 passed (90)`, `Tests  1313 passed (1313)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes the test file (1 hit).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; each mutation proven on disk and each restore proven blob == HEAD with an empty git diff HEAD)</summary>

The subject is imported by relative path, so it resolves to `src/`. No `dist/` leg applies.

- A, installed-side pre-resolve removed (`packageUpgradeSideOf(installed);` → `void installed;`): 2 failed. The installed-copy pin answers `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` "…could not be read…", and the remedy pin fails at its first 422.
- B, incoming side labelled installed (`'incoming'` → `'installed'`): 2 failed, the incoming pin and the both-refused pin.
- C, installed side labelled incoming (the original defect): 1 failed. The installed-copy pin gets `Package 'com.example.suite' cannot be installed: …`.
- D, 2c″ incoming pre-resolve removed (`packageUpgradeSideOf(converted);` → `void converted;`): 5 failed, the three #34432 incoming pins plus the two #34583 incoming pins. Before the fixture fix, D was 10/10 green.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card asked the message to say "upgrade or remove the stored copy first". It names only removal (uninstall, then install). An upgrade through this door is the act being refused, and no other path rewrites the ledger copy, so naming an upgrade would advertise a way out that does not exist. The remedy pin runs the one that does exist.
- The stored copy in the pin is a real refusal on a real engine. Through a booted `ObjectQLPlugin`, `convertPackageBodyForward` leaves a stored package entry's bare `indexes[].unique: true` as it is, and `resolveStackCollection` then refuses it with `INVALID_ARTIFACT_PACKAGE_ENTRY` / 422. This was measured with a throwaway script that is not committed.
- Out of scope, reported to the seat and not filed here: the install-local dry run (`dryRun: true`) on a re-install reads the same stored copy through `manifest.planUpgrade` with no guard. With a booted engine's `planUpgrade`, the handler throws the resolver's 422 envelope instead of answering it. Measured at the handler with a throwaway probe that is not committed.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands at 32bda83ef0, 71 commands)</summary>

- 70 exit 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it needs a whole-workspace `pnpm build`), so it is NOT MEASURED locally and left to CI.
- `dispatch-gates --ran` with exit codes: `✓ … 71 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 70 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`.
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` → OK.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` → `VERDICT clean exit 0`. It merges cleanly with origin/main and with #34791, which touches the same two files.

</details>

Responsibility: the install-local door, step 2c″, in `packages/cloud-connection` (objectstack).
